# Munito AI (EU)

Use `munito-eu/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "munito-eu-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "munito-eu/aleph-alpha/kolibri-1",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `MUNITO_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.eu.munito.ai/inference/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `MUNITO_EU_BASE_URL`.
